correctness.rationale: An actual standalone standard-library verifier enumerates all 125 perfect matchings by least-unmatched-vertex recursion and independently recounts using a subset-mask recurrence. Exactly 4055 nonempty faces are generated, with f-vector (30,315,1260,1575,750,125); every one of 15210 incidences is tested in the reversed-matched-arrow acyclicity test. There are 1977 pairs and critical cells in degrees 0:1, 2:62, 3:38. A directly reconstructed oriented 38-by-62 integral Morse differential undergoes exactly 19 unit unimodular pivot reductions leaving an all-zero residual matrix, determining 19 independent degree-three attaching maps that cancel two-spheres. Since the CW model has no one-cells, its attaching maps from S2 to a wedge of 62 S2 are classified by integral degree vectors, and the unimodular reduction proves a homotopy wedge of 43 S2 and 19 S3. Independent mod-2 original simplicial boundary ranks corroborate the Betti counts; the limitation is the exact finite graph, not an inferred infinite family.

value.rationale: The icosahedron is an intrinsic canonical claw-free planar five-regular graph motivating matching-extension investigations. Every two-edge matching extends to a perfect matching, while exactly 140 three-edge matchings fail, giving a natural first higher obstruction and a nontrivial pure five-dimensional complex. Its integral homotopy type is a mixed-dimensional wedge of 43 S2 and 19 S3, in contrast to the previously indexed ordinary matching complex with three-primary torsion. The full homotopy classification is a motivated finite geometric invariant, not merely a face count or routine reparameterization.
